comment:
* Retransmitter represents a class that will send a message and trigger delayed retransmissions * *

The Retransmitter class will queue retransmission signals on the provided handler. The owner * of this retransmitter instance is expected to wait for the signal, and call retransmit() on the * instance of this class.

variables.name: STATE_RETRANSMISSION_ALLOWED
variables.comment:
* Retransmission allowed state. Initial state when created. * *

This state allows packet transmission.

variables.name: STATE_RETRANSMISSION_SUSPENDED
variables.comment:
* Retransmission suspended state. * *

This state does not allow packet transmission.

variables.name: STATE_RETRANSMISSION_FINISHED
variables.comment:
* Retransmission finished state. * *

This state does not allow packet transmission.

methods.name: public void retransmit()
methods.comment:
* Triggers a (re)transmission. Will enqueue a future retransmission signal on the given handler * *

This method will only transmit packets when the Retransmitter is in the * STATE_RETRANSMISSION_ALLOWED state

methods.name: public void stopRetransmitting()
methods.comment:
* Finish retransmitting and cancels any future retransmissions. * *

This function is called when all packet transmissions have been completed and any future * next retransmission is no longer needed.

methods.name: public void suspendRetransmitting()
methods.comment:
* Suspends retransmitting. * *

Cancels any future retransmissions and sets the state to the Suspended. Retransmission can * only be resumed using the {@link #restartRetransmitting()}.

methods.name: public void restartRetransmitting()
methods.comment:
* Restarts retransmitting. * *

Resumes a retransmission suspended by {@link #suspendRetransmitting} and retransmission * starts again from the beginning by resetting retransmit count. * *

The state finished by {@link #stopRetransmitting()} will not be restarted again.

methods.name: public IkeMessage getMessage()
methods.comment: Retrieves the message this retransmitter is tracking

methods.name: protected abstract void handleRetransmissionFailure()
methods.comment:
* Callback for implementations to be informed that we have reached the max retransmissions. * *

For Retransmitter-internal use only.
